Requirement: The system shall provide a clear, responsive user interface framework that supports mode-based operation, safe inputs, and consistent operator feedback.
Traces from (Spec IDs): SPEC-001, SPEC-002, SPEC-003, SPEC-011, SPEC-016, SPEC-018, SPEC-020, SPEC-021, SPEC-022, SPEC-024
Verification activities: Inspection/Test: confirm UI groups controls by mode; input validation prevents invalid commands; destructive actions require confirmation; layout scales on target devices.
Validation Notes: A new user can identify mode/state and complete basic tasks without guidance.

Requirement: The system shall support teleoperation from a safe distance, allowing the operator to command end-effector targets and receive real-time feedback.
Verification activities: Test: command targets via UI (XY drag, Z adjustment, speed); confirm feedback updates and commands are rate-limited/safe.
Validation Notes: Operator can reach intended targets reliably and feels in control.

Requirement: The system shall allow non-specialist users to teach tasks by recording, editing, and managing waypoint-based routines (subroutines) without code changes.
Traces from (Spec IDs): SPEC-002, SPEC-009, SPEC-014, SPEC-016, SPEC-018, SPEC-020, SPEC-027, SPEC-028
Verification activities: Test: record waypoints (pose+dwell); edit/reorder/rename; save/load routines; confirm deterministic content and consistent naming/colour mapping.
Validation Notes: User can teach and replay a routine within ~1 hour onboarding.

Requirement: The system shall execute taught routines autonomously via a playback/timeline engine with safe start/stop controls, progress indication, and fault stop behaviour.
Traces from (Spec IDs): SPEC-001, SPEC-002, SPEC-014, SPEC-016, SPEC-018, SPEC-020, SPEC-021, SPEC-022, SPEC-024
Verification activities: Test: build timeline; start/pause/resume/cancel; verify sequential execution, progress UI, and stop on fault/E-stop.
Validation Notes: Demonstrate 'teach once, run repeatedly' with minimal operator intervention.

Requirement: The system shall enforce safety measures including homing/safe pose, workspace/joint limits, and fault handling to prevent unsafe motion.
Verification activities: Test: limits reject out-of-bounds; home moves to safe pose; faults halt playback and require reset/acknowledge.
Validation Notes: Demonstrate safe behaviour under misuse and fault scenarios.

Requirement: The system shall compute kinematics (IK/FK) and generate stable motion commands (jogging, smoothing, rate limits) to achieve commanded targets consistently.
Verification activities: Analysis/Test: validate IK/FK on known points; jogging respects limits; smoothing prevents abrupt steps; commands remain within servo ranges.
Validation Notes: Motion appears stable and repeatable to observers.

Requirement: The system shall persist configuration, routines, and timelines in human-readable, versioned formats and reload them deterministically on startup.
Traces from (Spec IDs): SPEC-001, SPEC-002, SPEC-006, SPEC-019, SPEC-020, SPEC-021, SPEC-023, SPEC-024, SPEC-027
Verification activities: Test: config directory created; JSON schema_version/timestamps present; load/save round-trip maintains behaviour; archives export correctly where required.
Validation Notes: Users can back up, share, and restore configurations/routines reliably.

Requirement: The system shall provide clear state/configuration/error signalling via UI and LED outputs using a defined legend
Verification activities: Test: set logical states (ready/running/teach/fault) updates LEDs; LED failures do not crash core control; legend documented.
Validation Notes: Operator can interpret status correctly at a glance.

Requirement: The system shall support end-effector actions (e.g., gripper open/close) and associated I/O/channel control integrated into waypoint routines.
Verification activities: Test: add gripper actions to waypoints; playback actuates correct channel; configuration supports tool offsets where applicable.
Validation Notes: End-effector actions occur at correct steps during execution.

Requirement: The system shall be testable and reproducible, providing dry-run/simulation options where applicable and maintaining controlled dependencies for build/execute.
Verification activities: Inspection/Test: pinned dependencies file present; basic self-test/unit tests exist for critical modules; dry-run does not actuate motors.
Validation Notes: Team can reproduce setup on a new machine without ad-hoc fixes.
